about: Removable drives flyout like Windows 11's "Safely Remove Hardware": Windows' name, a small menu-like flyout as tall as its entries, one plain list (no type headings, no sideways scroll bar), each drive an "Eject ..." entry that removes it safely and says so in a notification. Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13).
